$comment: Figma references for the About Vision & Mission section. Fetched once from the Figma MCP server and never regenerated from the browser. The visual tests refuse to run if any file's SHA-256 differs from this record. To refresh: fetch again from Figma, replace the files, update the hashes and the date, and say so in the commit.

references.note: Group 15 children are listed flat with section-relative boxes (the metadata response gives them section-relative inside a group, which the loader would otherwise nest). Values cross-checked against the design context left/top/width/height.

Hand-written summary of layer order, colours, gradient and sizes from the tool response, with a provenance header. Identity of the photo: the PNG downloaded from Figma (406:3565) is byte-identical (SHA-256 f2b3a3b476aec384679006b862522471fac22b2357ca658ef40333f2168e78f7) to the 4096x2731 image embedded in the repo's old vision.svg, now shipped as public/assets/about/vision-people.png.

unavailable.reason: No Arabic About frame in 406:3362. AR is checked as a derived composition: Figma specifies no mirroring, so the photo and cut-out are never mirrored; only the column order follows the page direction.
Every frame on the Final design page is 1440 wide; no tablet/mobile About frames.
